reviews.title: Good Quality Headset
reviews.comment: I wanted a headphone/mic set that would allow me to take advantage of speech to text functions, dictation to AI and maybe even some gaming or music listening on the computer. These seem to check off all those requirements. First, these are very comfortable to wear. The 'cloud' name is appropriate for the ear and headband pads. They are adjustable for ear positions and the detachable & adjustable mic works well. The noise cancellation worked well enough for me as I don't hear any outside noise. I like the option for connecting as they have 3.5mm jack, USB and USB-C cables/adapter. With the USB cable adapter, it is more than long enough to reach my computer. The headphone sound was really quite good especially for this price point. The mic picks up sound well enough though comes though a little on the quiet side. Connecting was easy as windows picked it up immediately when plugged in and made it the default. I'm quite happy with these and the price was a good value.
reviews.author: CGDot

reviews.title: great headset for a great price
reviews.comment: comfortable, clean audio, and working surround, all for under $100.  great headset if you're not looking to buy some $150+ premium setup and just want a good reliable headset to play some games.
reviews.author: Richard Demyan

reviews.title: I love it
reviews.comment: I’ve been using this wired gaming headset for about a month now and it’s been great for the price. Sound quality is clear, especially for gaming - easy to hear footsteps and in-game details. The mic works well too, and my teammates say my voice comes through clearly. It’s also comfortable for longer sessions and I like not having to deal with charging or connection issues. Overall, solid, reliable headset and definitely worth it.
reviews.author: Norah Jaques

reviews.title: Solid upgrade over Cloud II.  Watch out for the awkward volume dial.
reviews.comment: This headset is great.  I love the cloud II.  I love this more than the Cloud II.  Sounds much better and I come in clear for my friends. The headset is comfortable over my large head and overall feels solid. I thought the sound was a bit low and muffled but it turns out that there's a volume control and it's easy to accidently lower it.
reviews.author: ion

reviews.title: Great find!
reviews.comment: Not an audiophile, but sound quality is solid, mic sounds good, and has been comfortable to wear for extended periods of time.  I feel I've gotten great value for what I paid - I've been pretty happy with it!
reviews.author: Mike
